typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Dw_Run_Key as integer (),
	G_Run_End_DT as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		IOGateNo as string,
		IOGateName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT IOGateNo, IOGateName FROM  [GateData]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLESRCIODATA	source(output(
		Gate_No as string,
		Gate_Name as string,
		Facility as string,
		IsMainGate as boolean
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT Gate_No       ,Gate_Name       ,Facility             ,IsMainGate       FROM dbo.DIM_GATE',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LKPIODATALKPTABLE
OLESRCIODATA derive(Dw_Run_Key = $Dw_Run_Key,
		Dw_Create_Dt = $G_Run_End_DT,
		IsMainGate = iif((((locate('MAIN', upper(IOGateName), 1) > 0) && (IOGateName != 'BW-F6-MAIN DOOR')) || (((locate('GE-', upper(IOGateName), 1) > 0) || (locate('AP', upper(IOGateName), 1) > 0) || (locate('NG', upper(IOGateName), 1) > 0) || (locate('BT', upper(IOGateName), 1) > 0)) && (locate('QUIET ROOM', upper(IOGateName), 1) > 0))), true(), false()),
		Facility = iif(iif(iif(iif(iif(locate('GE-', upper(IOGateName), 1) > 0, 'Bitwise Genesis', locate('GL-', upper(IOGateName), 1) > 0), 'Bitwise Globus', locate('AP', upper(IOGateName), 1) > 0), 'Bitwise Apex', locate('NG-', upper(IOGateName), 1) > 0), 'Bitwise NextGen', locate('BT-', upper(IOGateName), 1) > 0), 'Bitwise TerraTower', 'Bitwise World')) ~> DERIODATA
LKPIODATALKPTABLE select(mapColumn(
		Gate_No = Gate_No,
		Gate_Name = Gate_Name,
		Facility_newRenamed = Facility,
		IsMainGate_newRenamed = IsMainGate
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LKPIODATALKPTABLE0
DERIODATA,LKPIODATALKPTABLE0 lookup(IOGateNo == Gate_No,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LKPIODATA
LKPIODATA split(isMatch(), disjoint: true) ~> LKPIODATAIsMatch@(Match,NotMatch)
LKPIODATAIsMatch@Match split((IOGateName != Gate_Name) || Facility != Facility_newRenamed || IsMainGate != IsMainGate_newRenamed, disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(ChangedGates,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
LKPIODATAIsMatch@NotMatch sink(input(
		DW_Create_Dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Gate_No as string,
		Gate_Name as string,
		Facility as string,
		DW_Run_Key as integer,
		IsMainGate as boolean
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DW_Create_Dt = Dw_Create_Dt,
		Gate_No = IOGateNo,
		Gate_Name = IOGateName,
		Facility,
		DW_Run_Key = Dw_Run_Key,
		IsMainGate)) ~> OLEDSTDIMGATE
ConditionalSplit@ChangedGates sink(input(
		IOGateName as string,
		Facility as string,
		IsMainGate as boolean,
		IOGateNo as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		IOGateName = Param_0,
		Facility = Param_1,
		IsMainGate = Param_2,
		IOGateNo = Param_3)) ~> OLEDBCommand
